name: Cornelius Van Wyck Lawrence
bioAdditions: Lawrence 1858 (S1) spells out the line in its own words: 'the eldest son of Henry Lawrence, who was the son of the second Joseph who was the son of Richard, who was the son of the first Joseph who was the son of the first William and Elizabeth Smith, afterwards Lady Carterett'. With Elizabeth a daughter of Bull Smith, that is 6 generations: 5th cousin 6 times removed. He married (1) Maria C. Prall, (2) Rachel A. Hicks, (3) Mrs E. N. Lawrence.

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), p. 51
